caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of aged wood, vertically oriented, with rough, irregular edges and visible wood grain. On the wooden surface, there is a painted image of a standing figure with hands pressed together in a praying gesture. The figure has a pale, yellowish face, dark hair, and is wearing a long, flowing garment in faded shades of blue, green, and yellow. Around the head of the figure is a halo or aureole rendered in yellowish tones, extending to a faint reddish and orange background behind the upper portion of the figure. There are several dark, irregular lines and shadows, possibly indicating damage or aging of the painted surface. The piece of wood itself has two small, round holes near the top edge, and the background of the image outside the wooden panel is an off-white or beige color.
title: Santo (Lady of Guadaloupe)
